subject: Change Redis to Valkey in log messages (#226)
reason: The change only rewrites log message text (serverLog/serverPanic strings in acl.c, cluster_legacy.c, eval.c) to say Valkey instead of Redis, introducing a SERVER_TITLE macro in version.h. No command reply, INFO output, protocol behavior, control flow, or persisted/replicated state changes: the exit(1) paths and all logic are identical, and log text is not covered by any oracle or comparable client-visible surface. No scenario can meaningfully exercise or detect this change.
